name: Watchtower Siege
description: Infiltrate the Fallen Watchtower and clear the goblin occupiers.

narrative.accept: Guard Captain Vaelen points to the map. "The Fallen Watchtower has become a goblin stronghold. We need you to breach their defences and clear out the occupiers."
narrative.complete: "You made it back! The watchtower is ours again, and Eldoria is safer for it. Take this reward, you've earned it."
narrative.hint: Travel to Fallen Watchtower and explore it.
